coreMemory.english: n. a cause or explanation for something；v. to think carefully and form a judgment
coreMemory.structure: the reason for /ðə ˈriːzən fɔr/（……的原因）；reason why /ˈriːzən waɪ/（……的理由）；main reason /meɪn ˈriːzən/（主要原因）；for some reason /fɔr sʌm ˈriːzən/（出于某种原因）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use reason with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of reason in context；❌ translate reason word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “the reason for”

commonErrors.wrong: use reason with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈriːzən wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of reason in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈriːzən ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。

commonErrors.right: learn the complete phrase “the reason for”
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /lɝn ðə kəmplit freɪz ðə ˈriːzən fɔr/
commonErrors.note: 不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
